nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Authoritative operations manual for the dev_graph Engineering Digital Twin, defining the full ontology governance: 24 node types, frontmatter schemas, canonical IDs, relationship model, lint workflow (11 checks), schema evolution procedures, context pack assembly, and end-of-session writeback checklist.
nodes.languageNotes: 56 sections covering the complete lifecycle of ontology-governed nodes — from frontmatter enums through confidence lifecycle, MCP operations policy, and Neo4j writeback procedure.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Human-readable orientation guide for the dev_graph vault, explaining its purpose as an Engineering Digital Twin, its relationship to the wiki, quick-start instructions, MCP access points, and directory structure overview.

nodes.name: index.md
nodes.summary: Master index of all dev_graph nodes across 23 directories (architecture, systems, capabilities, knowledge assets, patterns, interfaces, events, governance, modules, files, tests, gates, predicates, schemas, workflows, agents, skills, benchmarks, and more), with section-level navigation and statistics.

nodes.name: log.md
nodes.summary: Chronological operations log capturing all dev_graph sessions from the initial bootstrap (2026-05-25) through the Execution Layer STEP 4 writeback (2026-06-16), recording nodes created/updated, code shipped, ADRs authored, lint results, and metrics per session.
nodes.languageNotes: 147 sections spanning 20+ discrete session entries; functions as the authoritative change audit trail for the dev_graph ontology, referenced by the writeback checklist in CLAUDE.md.
